notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (tier 1) sufficient throughout; same robots.txt/Cloudflare notes as bs227.json -- ClaudeBot is disallowed but generic HTTP fetch under User-agent: * Allow: / was used, no Claude-in-Chrome escalation needed. Discovery: main nav/header carousel has a 'NEW IN' link to /collections/new-in; opened it and confirmed page <title>Nestasia New Arrivals - Latest Arrivals in Home Decor & Giftings</title> -- a genuine browsable PLP representing recently-added catalogue items, matching the target terms exactly. Verified exact count by exhaustive /collections/new-in/products.json paging (limit=250): page1=250, page2=79 (<250, end), 329 unique product ids after dedup, no cross-page duplicates. Checked sitemap_collections_1.xml for other new/arrival-worded handles: (1) /collections/new-arrivals -- despite the handle name, page <title>Never On Discount | Nestasia</title> -- this is NOT a New Arrivals page at all, it is a different merchandising concept (items never put on discount); EXCLUDED. (2) /collections/new-in-at-nest -- <title>New In at Nest | Nestasia</title>; products.json page1 (250 products) had 100% id-overlap with /collections/new-in's product set (all 250 ids present in new-in's 329) -- treated as an ALIAS of the same underlying listing, not counted separately; canonical kept as /collections/new-in since it is the one linked in main site navigation. (3) /collections/new-in-on-discount -- <title>New In - On Discount | Nestasia</title> -- a discount-filtered subset/promo cross of New In and Sale, not a separate genuine New-Arrivals concept; EXCLUDED. No genuine site-exposed New Arrivals sub-structure (e.g. per-category New Arrivals children) was found in nav or on the New In page itself, so only the single undifferentiated listing is emitted.
